decision.reason: Honest opening and clear recommendation; timeline contradicts itself; research language ('search snippets', 'secondary publication') in the copy; no Hoi An; generic concierge.

findings.issue: No cost picture; risk of paying venue deposits before the legal answer not mentioned (advice only, no figures).
Timeline table contradictory (NOIM in arrival week; CNI twice) and sample week contradicts 5 to 10 working days.
Research method language in the copy ('search snippets', 'secondary publication of the law text') lowers trust; say 'official sources differ' or 'confirm with the office' instead.
No named people or Vietnam experience; pay model (CONCIERGE-PAY).
Hoi An never named in the text.
Repetition of the non-resident answer; Hague objection detail.

payload.in_their_words: The most useful bit was being told straight away that two Aussies might not be able to marry legally in Vietnam... the timeline doesn't add up, there's nothing about Hoi An.
